title: Route map
idea: Route map: Connected nodes and a destination detail expose route tradeoffs
audience: People who need to choose route within a game surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic expedition layout through its choose route priority and explicit commitment contract: Selection and committed travel are distinct
navigation: Route map keeps the current choose route context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Connected nodes and a destination detail expose route tradeoffs
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to choose route; path choice changes subsequent play
composition.priority: Selection and committed travel are distinct

imagery.role: Support the actual choose route context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer sequential node list for non-spatial navigation
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the route map structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no choose route content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Selection and committed travel are distinct
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized choose route content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Selection and committed travel are distinct
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active choose route context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json.
